answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake real computational resources on a private island of verified data processing, where an orchard of historical interaction proofs is maintained and audited by a falcon-speed anomaly detector. Creating fake identities forces the attacker to duplicate the entire resource commitment and proof orchard for every identity, multiplying the cost linearly with the number of sybils and making large-scale attacks prohibitively expensive.
